task.description:
Your original implementation attempt (step-03-elixir-dev-implement.json) correctly FAILED and traced a real 4th failure mechanism. CODE-DESIGNER reworked the design and, in the course of verifying its rework, itself edited test/support/tenant_fixture.ex, test/letflow/secrets_test.exs, and test/letflow/webhooks_test.exs to the currently-committed, working state (removing the broken restore_sandbox mechanism, leaving only a moduledoc note plus async: false -> true on the two files). CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR has already independently regated this and personally ran the two-file scoped test suite twice with different seeds, both 38/38 clean.

Your job is a SIGN-OFF, not a re-implementation: as the roster's exclusive owner of shipped lib//test/ content (per docs/agents/AGENT_SYSTEM.md's capability matrix), confirm this is content you are willing to stand behind as ELIXIR-DEV's own delivered work, before REVIEWER's idiom gate. Concretely:

1. Read the actual current diff (git diff origin/main -- test/support/tenant_fixture.ex test/letflow/secrets_test.exs test/letflow/webhooks_test.exs) yourself.
2. Run mix format --check-formatted and mix compile --warnings-as-errors yourself, fresh, and confirm both clean.
3. Run mix test test/support/tenant_fixture.ex test/letflow/secrets_test.exs test/letflow/webhooks_test.exs yourself, at least once, and confirm 0 failures -- this is now the THIRD independent party (after CODE-DESIGNER's own verification and CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR's regate) to run this exact scoped suite; if you get a different result than both prior parties reported, that is a real, load-bearing finding -- report it as a BLOCKER, do not assume you made a mistake.
4. If you find anything about the diff that is not idiomatic Elixir/OTP style for this codebase, or that you would have implemented differently in a way that matters (not merely a style preference), say so -- you are not obligated to rubber-stamp a design-step's own code, and REVIEWER's own gate is a second, independent check regardless of your answer here.
5. If everything checks out, confirm you are satisfied with this as ELIXIR-DEV's own delivered implementation for ISS-0113/ISS-0423's converted-file scope.

Do NOT make any further code changes unless you find a genuine defect in step 4 -- this is confirmation, and any additional change you make must itself be re-verified by a fresh scoped test run before you report it.
acceptance_criteria: Actual current diff read directly, not assumed from prior handoffs' prose
mix format --check-formatted and mix compile --warnings-as-errors run fresh and confirmed clean
Scoped mix test run fresh (third independent party) and confirmed 0 failures, or a discrepancy from prior reports flagged as a BLOCKER
Idiom/style concerns, if any, stated explicitly rather than silently accepted
Explicit sign-off statement (satisfied / not satisfied, with reason) as the outcome

(2) mix format --check-formatted: clean, exit 0. mix compile --warnings-as-errors --force: clean, 190 files, exit 0, zero warnings. (3) mix test test/support/tenant_fixture.ex test/letflow/secrets_test.exs test/letflow/webhooks_test.exs: Result: 38 passed (1 property, 37 tests), 0 failures, exit 0, seed 840049 (a third, independently-random seed, distinct from both prior parties' seeds) -- identical outcome to CODE-DESIGNER's own verification and CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR's regate. No discrepancy to report. (4) Idiom/style review: no concerns. The diff is pure documentation (moduledoc additions matching this codebase's existing backtick-reference/## -section style) plus the two async flag flips called for -- no new runtime branching, no new abstraction, no change to provision_schema!/2, TenantProvisioning, or any production path. This is a net code-shrink relative to the original (reverted) restore_sandbox mechanism, consistent with 'don't add abstractions the requirement doesn't need.' (5) Sign-off: SATISFIED. I stand behind this as ELIXIR-DEV's own delivered implementation for ISS-0113/ISS-0423's converted-file scope (test/support/tenant_fixture.ex, test/letflow/secrets_test.exs, test/letflow/webhooks_test.exs).
